title: Water pushed over a mountain range
text: The concrete canal running down this side of the valley is the California Aqueduct, and it has a mountain range to get over. At the Edmonston Pumping Plant, {distance} from here, it is lifted 1,926 feet to cross the Tehachapi Mountains. Fourteen pumps of 80,000 horsepower each do the lifting, and the plant can draw 787 megawatts down a power line of its own.

s3.title: Edmonston Pumping Plant
s3.quote: There are 14 4-stage 80,000 horsepower (60 MW) centrifugal pumps ... The station needs up to 787 MW of electricity, delivered through a dedicated 230kV transmission line

s4.title: Interstate 5 in California
s4.quote: For most of this section, the Path 15 electrical transmission corridor follows the highway, forming an infrastructure corridor along with the California Aqueduct.
